title: Track guide Oulton Park - Island Ray FF1600 - Fixed iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Turn-in left, apex last quarter curb
corners.exit: Full throttle, use outside astro turf
corners.mistakes: Avoid hitting the little hill on the inside

corners.braking: Break hard when car tops the hill, trail brake to apex
corners.line: Overshoot the corner, get close to the curb at the top
corners.exit: Full throttle, open steering on exit
corners.mistakes: Lock up tires easily, miss the curb

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Midway between 100 and 50 boards, break hard, trail brake to first tire barrier
corners.mistakes: Going into Turn 5 too fast compromises the rest of the section

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: brake marker is discolored spot, brake to 50% pressure, trail brake to first curb
corners.line: take inside curb, use outside curb for overtaking
corners.mistakes: don't heat inside curbs, easy to slide out

corners.braking: brake marker is discolored part of track, brake hard to apex
corners.line: apex is emergency road, late third of corner
corners.mistakes: easy to overshoot apex, rear can go around

general_tips: Turn 5 is a good overtaking opportunity
Defend by being on the inside
